reader_summary.headline: We dive into the history behind Meituan, the juggernaut Chinese "super-app" which dominates China's services economy.
reader_summary.overview: We dive into the history behind Meituan, the juggernaut Chinese "super-app" which dominates China's services economy, offering consumers everything from food delivery, restaurant reviews, travel booking. Already China's 3rd largest tech company by market cap (behind just Tencent and Alibaba). What makes it so special, and how were they able to become the market leader in such a competitive space?

key_points.text: We dive into the history behind Meituan, the juggernaut Chinese "super-app" which dominates China's services economy, offering consumers everything from food delivery, restaurant reviews.
Already China's 3rd largest tech company by market cap (behind just Tencent and Alibaba).
This story is packed with lessons that apply equally beyond China tech to high-growth company building and investing everywhere.
